craft_notes: Sthāyin: denial-verse 2 (two-word close). Sanskrit: na...na...na ca → L4 truncates line 2 to 'not power-formed' (the abrupt close IS the music — shortest close in the song). Rows: row 1 (list uncut). Rejected: padding line 2 — killed: brevity is the point; 'not in any form' — killed: power-formed kept.

lines: Not nāda-drop, not moon's checks, not wheel-joined —
l4.sanskrit_cite: nādabindumayo vāpi na candrārdhanirodhikāḥ | na cakrakramasambhinno na ca śaktisvarūpakaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Is it nāda-drop or wheel-joined? → Sound-imagery denied too — the power-form is none of its pictures.
c1_essence: Not nāda-drop, not moon-blockers, not wheel-joined.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder of the unspeakable)
